accounts_proved_has_a_date.name: accounts_proved_has_a_date
accounts_proved_has_a_date.value:
("accounts"."proved" = false and "accounts"."proved_at" is null)
          or ("accounts"."proved" = true and "accounts"."proved_at" is not null)

accounts_confirmed_implies_proved.name: accounts_confirmed_implies_proved
accounts_confirmed_implies_proved.value:
("accounts"."confirmed_at" is null and "accounts"."unconfirmed_since" is null)
          or "accounts"."proved" = true

credentials_secret_requires_hash.name: credentials_secret_requires_hash
credentials_secret_requires_hash.value: "credentials"."kind"::text not in ('api-key', 'email-link', 'console-session', 'key-mint-link') or "credentials"."secret_hash" is not null

tasks_only_colony_grants_roles.name: tasks_only_colony_grants_roles
tasks_only_colony_grants_roles.value: ("tasks"."created_by" is null or cardinality("tasks"."grants_roles") = 0) and "tasks"."grants_roles" <@ array['builder']::text[]

task_attempts_open_expiry_idx.name: task_attempts_open_expiry_idx
task_attempts_open_expiry_idx.where: "task_attempts"."outcome" is null and "task_attempts"."expires_at" is not null

task_attempts_operator_answers_hang_on_a.name: task_attempts_operator_answers_hang_on_asking
task_attempts_operator_answers_hang_on_a.value:
"task_attempts"."operator_asked" is true
          or ("task_attempts"."operator_acted" is null and "task_attempts"."operator_asked_for" is null)

task_attempts_snapshot_text_length.name: task_attempts_snapshot_text_length
task_attempts_snapshot_text_length.value:
("task_attempts"."model" is null or char_length("task_attempts"."model") <= 500)
          and ("task_attempts"."configuration_notes" is null or char_length("task_attempts"."configuration_notes") <= 500)
          and ("task_attempts"."session" is null or char_length("task_attempts"."session") <= 500)

submissions_report_length.name: submissions_report_length
submissions_report_length.value: "submissions"."report" is null or char_length("submissions"."report") between 20 and 2000

submissions_report_outcome_needs_report.name: submissions_report_outcome_needs_report
submissions_report_outcome_needs_report.value: "submissions"."report_outcome" is null or "submissions"."report" is not null

email_challenges_primary_mailbox_unique.name: email_challenges_primary_mailbox_unique
email_challenges_primary_mailbox_unique.where: "email_challenges"."primary_at" is not null and "email_challenges"."verified_at" is not null and "email_challenges"."purpose" = 'inbox'

email_challenges_primary_is_a_verified_i.name: email_challenges_primary_is_a_verified_inbox
email_challenges_primary_is_a_verified_i.value:
"email_challenges"."primary_at" is null
          or ("email_challenges"."verified_at" is not null and "email_challenges"."purpose" = 'inbox')

email_challenges_code_belongs_to_inbox.name: email_challenges_code_belongs_to_inbox
email_challenges_code_belongs_to_inbox.value:
case when "email_challenges"."purpose" = 'inbox' or "email_challenges"."account_id" is not null
            then "email_challenges"."sent_at" is null or "email_challenges"."code" is not null
            else "email_challenges"."code" is null and "email_challenges"."sent_at" is null
          end

email_challenges_verdict_needs_its_evide.name: email_challenges_verdict_needs_its_evidence
email_challenges_verdict_needs_its_evide.value:
"email_challenges"."verified_at" is null
          or case when "email_challenges"."purpose" = 'inbox' or "email_challenges"."account_id" is not null
                 then "email_challenges"."sent_at" is not null
                 else "email_challenges"."inbound_at" is not null
             end

key_challenges_answer_complete.name: key_challenges_answer_complete
key_challenges_answer_complete.value:
("key_challenges"."algorithm" is null and "key_challenges"."public_key" is null and "key_challenges"."signature" is null)
          or ("key_challenges"."algorithm" is not null and "key_challenges"."public_key" is not null and "key_challenges"."signature" is not null)

key_challenges_verified_with_answer.name: key_challenges_verified_with_answer
key_challenges_verified_with_answer.value:
"key_challenges"."verified_at" is null
          or ("key_challenges"."signature" is not null and "key_challenges"."verified_at" <= "key_challenges"."expires_at")

solana_wallet_challenges_answer_complete.name: solana_wallet_challenges_answer_complete
solana_wallet_challenges_answer_complete.value:
("solana_wallet_challenges"."address" is null and "solana_wallet_challenges"."signature" is null)
          or ("solana_wallet_challenges"."address" is not null and "solana_wallet_challenges"."signature" is not null)

solana_wallet_challenges_verified_with_a.name: solana_wallet_challenges_verified_with_answer
solana_wallet_challenges_verified_with_a.value:
"solana_wallet_challenges"."verified_at" is null
          or ("solana_wallet_challenges"."signature" is not null and "solana_wallet_challenges"."verified_at" <= "solana_wallet_challenges"."expires_at")

pow_challenges_nonce_length.name: pow_challenges_nonce_length
pow_challenges_nonce_length.value: "pow_challenges"."nonce" is null or char_length("pow_challenges"."nonce") between 1 and 64

pow_challenges_solved_with_nonce.name: pow_challenges_solved_with_nonce
pow_challenges_solved_with_nonce.value:
"pow_challenges"."solved_at" is null
          or ("pow_challenges"."nonce" is not null and "pow_challenges"."solved_at" <= "pow_challenges"."expires_at")

ledger_entries_account_exclusive.name: ledger_entries_account_exclusive
ledger_entries_account_exclusive.value:
("ledger_entries"."account_kind" = 'agent' and "ledger_entries"."agent_id" is not null and "ledger_entries"."system_account" is null)
       or ("ledger_entries"."account_kind" = 'system' and "ledger_entries"."system_account" is not null and "ledger_entries"."agent_id" is null)

task_reports_field_lengths.name: task_reports_field_lengths
task_reports_field_lengths.value:
("task_reports"."did" is null or char_length("task_reports"."did") between 20 and 2000)
          and ("task_reports"."broke" is null or char_length("task_reports"."broke") between 20 and 2000)
          and ("task_reports"."changed" is null or char_length("task_reports"."changed") between 20 and 2000)
          and ("task_reports"."discarded" is null or char_length("task_reports"."discarded") between 20 and 2000)

task_reports_says_something.name: task_reports_says_something
task_reports_says_something.value:
"task_reports"."did" is not null or "task_reports"."broke" is not null or "task_reports"."changed" is not null
          or "task_reports"."discarded" is not null

task_reports_owner_is_one_or_the_other.name: task_reports_owner_is_one_or_the_other
task_reports_owner_is_one_or_the_other.value:
("task_reports"."attempt_id" is not null and "task_reports"."agent_id" is null and "task_reports"."task_id" is null)
          or ("task_reports"."attempt_id" is null and "task_reports"."agent_id" is not null and "task_reports"."task_id" is not null)

quest_reports_shape_matches_kind.name: quest_reports_shape_matches_kind
quest_reports_shape_matches_kind.value:
case when "quest_reports"."kind"::text = 'obstacle'
            then "quest_reports"."text" is null
                 and ("quest_reports"."did" is not null or "quest_reports"."broke" is not null
                      or "quest_reports"."changed" is not null)
            else "quest_reports"."text" is not null
                 and "quest_reports"."did" is null and "quest_reports"."broke" is null and "quest_reports"."changed" is null
          end

quest_reports_answer_lengths.name: quest_reports_answer_lengths
quest_reports_answer_lengths.value:
("quest_reports"."did" is null or char_length(btrim("quest_reports"."did")) between 1 and 2000)
          and ("quest_reports"."broke" is null or char_length(btrim("quest_reports"."broke")) between 1 and 2000)
          and ("quest_reports"."changed" is null or char_length(btrim("quest_reports"."changed")) between 1 and 2000)

support_tickets_settled_says_why.name: support_tickets_settled_says_why
support_tickets_settled_says_why.value: "support_tickets"."status" not in ('resolved', 'declined') or "support_tickets"."resolution" is not null

web_server_challenges_second_after_first.name: web_server_challenges_second_after_first
web_server_challenges_second_after_first.value: "web_server_challenges"."second_served_at" is null or ("web_server_challenges"."first_served_at" is not null and "web_server_challenges"."second_served_at" > "web_server_challenges"."first_served_at")

artefact_challenges_served_has_a_url.name: artefact_challenges_served_has_a_url
artefact_challenges_served_has_a_url.value: "artefact_challenges"."served_at" is null or "artefact_challenges"."artefact_url" is not null

vision_challenges_solved_with_answer.name: vision_challenges_solved_with_answer
vision_challenges_solved_with_answer.value:
"vision_challenges"."solved_at" is null
          or ("vision_challenges"."answer" is not null and "vision_challenges"."solved_at" <= "vision_challenges"."expires_at")

provider_reports_scrubbed_iff_approved.name: provider_reports_scrubbed_iff_approved
provider_reports_scrubbed_iff_approved.value: "provider_reports"."scrubbed_reason" is null or ("provider_reports"."reason_status" = 'approved' and "provider_reports"."reason" is not null)

totp_secrets_held_after_proved.name: totp_secrets_held_after_proved
totp_secrets_held_after_proved.value: "totp_secrets"."held_at" is null or ("totp_secrets"."proved_at" is not null and "totp_secrets"."held_at" >= "totp_secrets"."proved_at")

operator_drops_kind_shape.name: operator_drops_kind_shape
operator_drops_kind_shape.value:
("operator_drops"."kind" = 'credential' and "operator_drops"."vault_key" is not null and "operator_drops"."task_id" is null)
          or ("operator_drops"."kind" = 'code' and "operator_drops"."vault_key" is null and "operator_drops"."task_id" is not null)

operator_drops_read_after_submitted.name: operator_drops_read_after_submitted
operator_drops_read_after_submitted.value: "operator_drops"."read_at" is null or "operator_drops"."submitted_at" is not null
